FASTVC-BENCH-CORPUS:chromium-main-v1-943b94ae-1c74-4335-94fa-ceb4d277cea8
Description

This test validates that the value of the window.performance.navigation.redirectCount attribute, as well as the window.performance.timing.redirectStart and redirectEnd attributes on a non-redirected navigation.


PASS window.performance is defined 
PASS window.performance.navigation is defined 
PASS timing.redirectStart on an non-redirected navigation 
PASS timing.redirectEnd on an non-redirected navigation 
PASS navigation.redirectCount on an non-redirected navigation
